subject: Update replica version comparison to handle version 8 RC candidates (#851)
reason: The change only alters how CLUSTER SETSLOT classifies a replica whose reported version falls in [7.2.255, 8.0.0) (the 8.0 release candidates): the primary now replicates SETSLOT to such replicas instead of using the non-replicated fallback. Reaching the branch requires a genuine cluster replica (the guard tests myself->num_replicas, which comes from cluster topology, not from a raw PSYNC/REPLCONF client), and a genuine replica of any build the fuzzer can run reports its VALKEY_VERSION.
